hints.Popeye: Squint one eye, clamp a pipe in your mouth, flex your arm, swallow a can of spinach, and bulge your muscles.
hints.Pink Panther: Tiptoe sneakily with long, smooth, cool strides, with a finger on your lips and a sly grin, like a spy in slow music.
hints.Road Runner: Zoom on the spot very fast with legs a blur, stick out your tongue and beep beep, then let a coyote crash behind you.
hints.Johnny Bravo: Flex your muscles, pat a huge pompadour, pose in sunglasses, and chat up a girl with a cheesy 'Hey there, mama' smile.
hints.Ben 10: Press a watch on your wrist, twist it, flash a green light, and transform into a monster, then fight.
hints.Doraemon: Reach into a front pocket of your tummy and pull out a gadget, then act as a round cat with no ears who is afraid of mice.
hints.Naruto: Run with your arms swept back behind you, make hand seals, make a clone, then do a big spinning blast in a swirl.
hints.Dragon Ball: Cup your hands at your hip, shout and focus, thrust them forward to shoot a beam, and power up with spiky hair.
hints.Courage the Cowardly Dog: Be a shivering dog, scream with huge eyes at a ghost in the window, hide, and then bravely save the owners.
hints.Tweety and Sylvester: Be a tiny bird with a baby voice, a big head and a cage, and a big cat chasing, always failing and crashing.
hints.Inside Out: Show five different feelings in your face, one after another, joy, sadness, anger, fear, disgust, and a ball of memory.
hints.Up: Be an old man holding on to a bunch of balloons, floating a house into the sky, with a little scout next to you.
